title: Submission changes, event format 1
description: What changed between two answer documents of one submission: the `changes` of a submission:edit event, and what a form app sends when it saves an edit. See docs/submission_changes.md for the rules this schema cannot express.

set.description: Answers that are new or different, each with its whole new value.

unset.description: Keys of answers that were removed.

rows.description: Row-by-row changes to repeaters whose rows all carry a uuid, keyed by the repeater's key.

order.description: Every row's uuid, in their new order. Present when a row was added, removed or moved; a row left out is removed.

added.description: New rows, whole, keyed by their uuid.

changed.description: Changes to existing rows, keyed by their uuid. Each is the same shape as the whole, so a repeater inside a row is changed row by row too.
